item.title: What other options do I have
item.description:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA512

Microsoft just refuses any sort of communication, always ghosting me even when I ask for anything.
Pretty sure they have an absolute don't reply to him policy over there, it's not doing them any favours for now.
I can't even report the bugs I find to their respective vendors because of the restrictions by Microsoft, all of this is of their own doing and you know, they don't even bother to check my case to figure out what's wrong. I asked for something very simple that Microsoft could easily do to help me and this entire dilemma but got told to go fuck myself (in corpo grammar obviously)

Think I will start publishing bugs for third parties in that window where patch tuesday isn't released yet. I have a bunch, just haven't been in mood to check any of them + didn't eat anything for like 2 days so I got no energy and sleeping is just a nightmare while waking up is even worst. 

I wish if I did what you actually accused me of, all of this wouldn't have hurt me as much as it could have if I did the bs you accused me of. If you just do some rational thinking you'll figure out that I have absolutely zero motives/benefits of doing that bs and I still have no idea what happened exactly.

I was planning to do some tweaks on ShieldBreak but I don't even have enough energy to get out of bed, the one thing I'm constantly thinking about is I will eventually get kicked out of my place and I have nowhere else to go... If you hate me that much Microsoft why not just shoot me in the back of my head and be done with it, don't waste time. Isn't that what big corporations do ? Just murder anyone who disagrees with them ? Please hurry up I don't want to wait any longer...

I just want to live like a normal human being for once in my life, is that too much to ask for...?

item.title: Some interesting findings in Windows Defender
item.description:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA512

As many of you may have seen, Microsoft issued a security patch for RoguePlanet

https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-US/advisory/CVE-2026-50656

There is a problem in mpengine.dll, the newly introduced mitigations or as Microsoft calls them "defense-in-depth updates" can cause windows defender to leak 8 bytes of data while attempting to open a file in certain scenarios, I'm still trying to find a way to obtain the leaked bytes as a standard user but for now it only leaks data to drivers.

Now one thing I noticed with Windows Defender is the fact that it is very careful when handling file sizes, there is hard limits on how big the file can be when scanning and quarantining files. 
This implementation make sense, because quarantining a huge file will cause Defender to completely exhaust the available disk space.
I found a small exception to this rule, apparently the spynet functions in mpengine.dll really wants to keep a local copy of :Zone.Identifier ADS file and it does not matter how big this file is, Windows Defender will cache it locally anyways.

You will need a special setup to exploit this, a custom SMB server that will be handling requests from Windows Defender is needed, the SMB server should serve a malicious file (a good example is mimikatz executable) followed by a massive ADS file (a good example is mimikatz.exe:Zone.Identifier), in the process of replying to the read requests, at some point the SMB server should never respond to the read request but keep the connection alive. This will cause Defender to hang and keep a lock on the offending files that holds the entire disk space.
Obviously this won't crash the machine but windows won't behave properly with a full disk, multiple apps and services crash randomly.

I managed to reproduce this issue in Windows 11 25H2 and Windows Server 2025, visiting an SMB server will cause Defender to completely exhaust your disk space. I'm trying to get it to work with webdav so we can skip the authentication requirement, I'm not sure if it's possible because attempting to open an ADS in a webdav causes the request to fail with STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETERS, I'm not sure if it's a problem with my custom webdav implementation because it shows the ADS open attempt as a weird "file.exe/%3AZone.Identifier" so maybe I'm doing smtg wrong but it might work.

I was thinking about a way to exploit this remotely without needing a victim to open your special SMB server but nothing crossed my mind. If there was a way to convince Defender to scan files remotely then this issue is exploitable and would be very powerful against servers.

item.title: Microsoft is an interesting company
item.description:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA512

I guess I'm done with taking a break, it's time to get back to work.

I think July will be an incredibly interesting month because I will drop some really interesting and possibly insanely controversial findings. Such mistakes should not be allowed to exist after the damage it did but yet, it's still there. I feel like it's something I was not supposed to see but I really can't ignore it and it really blew my mind that Microsoft is letting me go this wild.

I won't even publish a full PoC, just some code to demonstrate that such flaw exists because obviously I can't just say there is a bug there go deal with it but this one will require some actual skill to exploit.

Also what's going on with windows defender team ? they're trying really hard to sweep up bugs with global mitigations... From what I see, it somehow managed to kill some of my findings but not all of them ? And it also made AV evasion waay more easier, it's just unfortunate that not many people are familiar with how Defender functions (obviously no sane person will open mpengine.dll in IDA and just stare at it all day every single day.) but now it's easier to bypass defender than ever.

item.title: Some updates about my current plans and more about the recent defender exploits, (RoguePlanet, RedSun, BlueHammer)
item.description:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA512

We moved from blogger after censorship unfortunately, after request a review from google they reinstated the deleted blogs but since we are here, we're continuing here and the google blog stays as a backup.

Now regarding the recent defender bugs, they were incredibly difficult to find and making a full exploit for them was brutal but I did it regardless.
I was aware of a special defender behaviour during the development of BlueHammer where using a special flag MPSCAN_OPTION_NOCONSOLIDATE will cause defender to not show a toast warning about it finding a threat it in the system (which was triggered by eicar)
After RedSun, I had my hands on some public ITW samples where they used this flag to hide the exploitation attempt from the user and since the RedSun had a guaranteed success rate, the pop-up just never shows up. While it still shows if you go check it in protection history or using EDR, but there was no immediate pop-up alerting the user that something was wrong.
During the development of RoguePlanet, I finally decided to include the flag, which can be found here - 
https://git.projectnightcrawler.dev/NightmareEclipse/RoguePlanet/src/branch/main/RoguePlanet.cpp#L78086
I'm not sure if many of you have noticed but if the exploit succeeds, no pup-up shows, only when the race fails. Same applied for BlueHammer and RedSun.

I have read many attempts to detect/block the PoC through signatures but none of them seem effective because small changes in the PoC can completely bypass your mitigations. The only thing you can realistically do is wait for a patch from Microsoft.

Now considering some recent life events, I got incredibly depressed and I was unable to get back up again and start writing code and I started questioning this whole thing in general. Usually Microsoft just does something that pisses me off so much I end up dropping bugs but recently they have been silent which contributed a bit to my pause. Unlike what they did for the past years, they seemingly chose to let the fire calm on it's own. I doubt it will work since eventually they will be forced to speak and they will definitely boil the blood in my veins and the whole cycle starts again. 
For now I'm taking a break.

Hope we meet again, friends.
